moderation.label: Moderation
moderation.description: Sanctions (warn, kick, ban, timeout), history and log.

kick.description: Kick a member from the server.

ban.description: Ban a member (or a user by their ID).

timeout.description: Time a member out for a duration (e.g. 10m, 1h, 1j).

opt.deleteDays: Delete messages from the last N days (0-7).
opt.userId: The ID of the user to unban.

targetError.owner: ❌ You can't sanction the server owner.
targetError.botHierarchy: ❌ This member has a role higher than or equal to mine: I can't sanction them.
targetError.modHierarchy: ❌ This member has a role higher than or equal to yours.

moderation.notInGuild: ❌ This member is not on the server.
moderation.botNoPerm: ❌ I'm missing the permission required for this action.
moderation.notBanned: ❌ This user is not banned (or the ID is wrong).

logChannelId.label: Moderation log channel
logChannelId.help: The channel where each sanction is recorded, with who issued it, against whom and why. Empty, sanctions still apply — there is simply no record left to consult, and « who banned this member in March? » has no answer.

dmOnSanction.label: DM the member when they are sanctioned
dmOnSanction.help: The sanctioned member gets a direct message telling them what happened and why. Discord refuses DMs from a server someone has left, and from members who have closed them: the send then fails without blocking the sanction.
